ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_margin_relu_weighted
ir.intuition: To increase novelty and reduce similarity, replaced the logsigmoid margin with a ReLU-based positive margin (max(0, log_prob_w - log_prob_l)) to directly encourage positive gaps only. This approach simplifies the margin while selectively rewarding only advantageous predictions, stabilizing gradients without negative margins. Retained advantage_gap weighting and importance weights to keep signal strength and importance weighting benefits. This change avoids logsigmoid and neg usage, breaking prior similarity patterns.
ir.pseudocode:
adv = advantage_gap
margin_raw = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
margin = relu(margin_raw)
loss = mean(weight * margin * adv)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']

    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin = ops.relu(margin_raw)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(margin, adv)
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
